mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session (movie_id, hall_id, start_time, end_time, price, language_version, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{movieId}, #{hallId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{price}, #{languageVersion}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE session SET movie_id = #{movieId}, hall_id = #{hallId}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, price = #{price}, language_version = #{languageVersion}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE session SET status = 2, update_time = Now() WHERE end_time < #{time}
